en: Black‑and‑white image showing soldiers drilling in formation in an open sandy yard bordered by young trees. Behind them stands a large two‑storey brick or stucco military building with a gabled roof and several chimneys, surrounded by a tall fence. More uniformed men stand near the fence and buildings, suggesting a barracks or training ground. The style looks early‑20th‑century European.
